observations.footwork: The fighter steps forward to close the distance towards the pad holder.
observations.guard: Hands are held up in a standard boxing guard.
observations.upper_body: The fighter throws a straight right hand (cross) into the pad holder's mitts.
observations.distance: Closes from long range to striking range, connecting with the mitts.
observations.notable: The pad holder actively presents the target mitts. The punch lands successfully.

observations.footwork: The fighter steps back, creating significant separation from the pad holder.
observations.guard: Hands remain partially raised but gradually begin to lower.
observations.upper_body: The fighter is retreating and turning slightly to the side.
observations.notable: There is a clear break in the action; the pad holder lowers the mitts.

observations.footwork: The fighter walks back towards the center of the frame and re-establishes a stance.
observations.guard: Hands return to a high, guarded position by the final frame.
observations.upper_body: The fighter is upright and resetting their position.
observations.distance: Re-establishes a medium to long range between the two.
observations.notable: The pad holder remains stationary, waiting for the fighter to reset.

movement_events.detail: The fighter steps forward to close the distance to the pad holder.
The fighter extends their right arm to throw a cross into the mitts.
The fighter retracts the right hand back to the guard.
The fighter steps back, creating space between themselves and the pad holder.
The fighter walks back to the starting position and re-establishes their stance.
